jei.cropgenetics.seed_conversion: Getting genetic seeds: (1) Place ONE Crop Stick on suitable farmland. (2) Right-click with a supported ordinary seed (wheat, carrot, potato, etc.). The planted crop now has baseline Growth/Gain/Strength 1/1/1. (3) Break the planted Crop Sticks to retrieve a Genetic Seed carrying those values. (4) Grow and cross plants to obtain inherited or improved values. TWO Crop Sticks on an empty plot are reserved for crossbreeding: a seed cannot be planted there directly. Only seeds registered by the active crop datapacks are supported; there is no crafting-table conversion. This JEI guide also appears for recognized seed candidates from Pam's HarvestCraft 2 and Farmer's Delight. Whether a seed is actually supported in this world depends on the active server datapacks; Farmer's Delight rice is excluded.
jei.cropgenetics.seed_recovery: Recover an original seed: Place one Genetic Seed and ONE sheet of paper in separate crafting slots. The output is one ordinary original seed without its genetic values. Paper is a reusable catalyst: every craft returns that sheet with all its individual components. A single sheet is enough for repeated conversions. JEI's illustrative recipe preview does not display the paper remainder. No output is available when the source item is missing or recovery would discard foreign data.
jei.cropgenetics.seed_analysis: Place the Seed Analyzer as a block. Right-click with a seed to insert one, or open its inventory with an empty hand. Analysis reveals the seed's existing Growth/Gain/Strength values; it does not generate or change them. Unanalyzed Genetic Seeds are nonstackable to preserve their individual genomes. Put a Seed Chest directly beside the Analyzer to see its 27 storage slots in the same menu. Craft a Seed Journal from a book and Crop Sticks, then put it into the Analyzer's second slot. Each analyzed plant species is recorded permanently in that particular journal. Right-click the journal in your hand to open the discovered plants book with pages.
